title: Baobab DeploymentObservation (ADR-BCP-025)
description:
Definition library for DeploymentObservation, a time-bounded report of what is actually running on one engine instance, and the observed release the Control Plane derives from it (ADR-BCP-025 section 2.6, gate ER-01). It follows the HealthObservation pattern (capability/v1 health.schema.json).
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/DeploymentObservation), not the document root.

Invariants the Control Plane enforces beyond these shapes:
  Observations come from infrastructure tooling registered for the instance's environment and region, authenticated by workload identity with the deployment:observe scope; never from the engine describing itself (section 2.9). An observation outside the reporter's registration is refused, never stored.
  Observations are append-only. recorded_at and ingestion_sequence are assigned by the Control Plane, never by the reporter.
  The current observation is the one with the latest observed_at; at equal observed_at the higher ingestion_sequence wins, so every replica derives the same one (release-policy.yaml current_observation).
  An expired, missing or future-dated observation means UNKNOWN.

Control Plane is the runtime authority. Shared is the contract authority.

ObservedArtifact.description: One artifact digest observed running. Only the digest identifies it; no tag or repository is accepted.

DeploymentObservationSubmission.description: What a registered reporter submits. The Control Plane mints observation_id, assigns recorded_at and ingestion_sequence, and takes source from the authenticated workload; none of them is accepted here. expires_at must be later than observed_at, within release-policy.yaml observation.ttl_seconds.

observed_at.description: When the reporter observed the instance, not when it was recorded.

expires_at.description: After this instant the observation says nothing, and the observed release is UNKNOWN until a newer observation arrives.

DeploymentObservation.description: One accepted observation (section 2.6). environment and region are what the reporter saw; a mismatch with the instance's own is DEPLOYMENT_LOCATION_MISMATCH drift, never an update to the instance.

recorded_at.description: When the Control Plane accepted the observation.

ingestion_sequence.description: Monotonically increasing across all accepted observations; the tie-breaker for equal observed_at.

ObservedRelease.description: The release an engine instance is observed running, derived from its current observation (section 2.6). release_id is set only for RELEASE; release_ids lists the releases a MIXED observation spans; observation_id is absent only for UNKNOWN because there is no current observation.
